_note: Every reader-visible string, by key (crates/core/src/page.rs). Words follow GLOSSARY.md and TONE.md. Strings marked as copied in SECOND-ORDER.md come from CHUMWORLD unchanged.
title: Chumworld Arena
no_webgl: This game draws with WebGL 2, which this browser has turned off or does not have. Turn on hardware acceleration in the browser's settings, or open the page in a current Chrome, Firefox or Safari.
swing_how: Hold the left button and move the mouse sideways for a level cut, up or down for a chop or a rising cut. Turn the wheel away for a thrust. Hold the right button to move the sword hand.
wound_take_up: X · Take up your sword in your other hand
title_text: A duel in a stone ring, seen from inside the helmet. Practice against the computer's knight, best of three rounds.
menu_text: Practice is a duel against the computer's knight, best of three rounds.
save_loaded: Save loaded. Your settings are the file's.
save_refused_file: That file was refused: {why} Your settings are as they were.
save_refused_stored: The save in this browser was refused: {why} The settings start from their defaults.
save_why_unreadable: it is not a save file.
save_why_format: it is a file of another kind, not this game's save.
save_why_version: it is from another version of the game.
save_why_checksum: it has been changed since it was written.
save_why_field: its "{field}" is not what a save holds.
sudden_death: Sudden death: stay inside the inner ring
fell_foe_blade: The knight fell to your blade.
fell_you_blade: You fell to the knight's blade.
fell_foe_sand: The knight fell outside the inner ring.
fell_you_sand: You fell outside the inner ring.
fell_both: Both knights fell at once. The round is fought again.
online_menu_note: Host and Join meet another browser by room code. Pasted codes do the same with no relay, when the relays fail.
paste_text: One player hosts and sends an invitation; the other pastes it, makes a reply and sends it back. No relay is used.
host_room_text: Give the other player this room code. They choose Join and type it; the duel begins when they arrive. You are the black helm.
join_room_text: Type the room code the host gave you, then choose Join. You are the ivory crown.
paste_host_text: Send this invitation to the other player. Paste their reply below and choose Accept the reply. You are the black helm.
paste_join_text: Paste the host's invitation and choose Make a reply. Send the reply back to the host. You are the ivory crown.
online.playing: The other player is here. The duel is on.
online.reload: The other player's game is another version. Both reload the page, then try again.
online.garbled: A message from the other player could not be read. The duel goes on.
online.left: The other player left the duel.
online.full: That room already has two players. Try another room code.
online.desync: Desync: the two browsers' duels no longer agree, so the duel stops here. This is a fault in the game.
online.timeout: No word from the other player for {seconds} seconds, so the duel has ended.
online.no_bundle: The code for room codes did not load. Reload the page, or use pasted codes.
online.no_relay: No relay answered. Try again, or use pasted codes.
online.no_path: The two browsers found no way to reach each other: both networks block a direct link, and this game has no relay to carry a duel.
online.signal_failed: The two browsers could not finish meeting. Try again, or use pasted codes.
online.bad_code: That is not a code from this game. Paste the whole code the other player sent.
online.bad_room: A room code is five letters, such as KMRTW.
online.not_online: Choose Host or Join on the menu first.
online.rematch_wait: Waiting for the other player to choose Rematch.
